summary: Backend-only test of NEW endpoint POST /api/action-items/import-from-pros-cons/{analysis_id} (Pros & Cons → Action Plan import, mirrors My Dezider MPPS import). All 6 pytest cases passed: happy-path import from CHOSEN option creates action_items with correct title format '[<factor> - <projected%>] · <text> · [+<delta>%]'; zero-delta factor produces no item; second POST is idempotent (imported_count=0, GET count unchanged); when final_choice_option_id is null the response is {imported_count:0, reason:'no_chosen_option'}; unauthenticated POST returns 401; existing My Dezider MPPS import route still resolves (404 for bogus decision id, route alive).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/action_items.py::import_from_pros_cons correctly: (a) returns 404 if analysis not found, (b) early-returns {imported_count:0, reason:'no_chosen_option'} when final_choice_option_id is unset, (c) skips factors with improvement_pct <= 0, (d) is idempotent via pc_key = '<chosen>|<factor>|<delta>', (e) self-heals existing titles if the format/values change, (f) clamps projected % to [0,100]. Behaviour parity with import_from_mpps confirmed.

PUT /api/pros-cons/{id}/config accepts final_choice_option_id=null (key present with None value passes the `if k in body` guard), which is required for the 'unset chosen option' test path. Confirmed working.
